name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-legend-ii-struggle-to-the-death-romancing-saga
title: Final Fantasy Legend II - Struggle to the Death (Romancing SaGa 1 Mix)
description:
A boss battle theme from Final Fantasy Legend II on Game Boy, redone with instruments from Romancing SaGa for SNES. Based on Nintendo DS remake Goddess of Destiny that has extended part.

This port uses the optimized SMW sample set. The track name is taken from English soundtrack release by Square Enix Music.
